claim: BUG DISCOVERED in StaticPolicyRouter._expand_entry / route(): per-task per-role known_overrides do NOT work. When attempting to promote E022 X215's routing (coder+aggregator=opus-4-8, rest=sonnet) into memory/routing/task_memory/image-classification-small.json[known_overrides.leaf-classification], CompositeRouter returned the FAMILY default (sonnet-all) regardless of override format tried. Root cause (verified by reading engine/routing/router.py lines 147-152): the lookup wraps the override in {'by_role': override} when by_role IS present, but expand_entry then sees {by_role: {by_role: {role: model, ...}}} — double wrapping — and the inner dict fails the isinstance(model, str) check for every 'role' it iterates. Flat override format (no by_role wrapper) also fails because expand_entry returns empty when entry has no 'default'/'all_roles'/'by_role' key. Workaround: callers must hand-write models_by_role in YAML; the autonomous family-level default_routing promotion (as for tabular-regression E029 and image-denoising-restoration E025) still works because that path goes through the family default branch (lines 153-156), not the known_overrides branch.
